market.advice: Pre-open read (US open ~9:30 ET): a cautiously-constructive tape under a defensive surface. SPY 738.93 is still ~2.5% off its high and back below its 50-day (744) with one distribution day and no follow-through — so the index has NOT proven itself. But the internals are better than the headline: breadth is healthy (69% of stocks above their 50-day), VIX is calm at 17.7, and the weekend US-Iran cease-fire pause has crude and the dollar falling, easing the biggest macro overhang. Leadership is squarely in quality value — REITs, insurers/banks, industrials, healthcare and utilities are printing new highs, while high-multiple tech, semis, crypto and space names remain deeply corrected (TSLA, ORCL, APP, PLTR, COIN, RGTI all 35-75% off highs). The swing factor is this week's Fed decision. Play it the way the tape is paying you: lean into A+ value/defensive breakouts at or near new highs, keep size modest, and let the beaten-down growth names reclaim their 50-day before chasing. Only take A+ setups until SPY reclaims 744 and delivers a follow-through day.
market.state_advice: Trade selectively. Modest size. Favor A+ value/defensive breakouts at new highs; let growth reclaim its 50-day before chasing.
